correctness.rationale: For each target the four-state de Bruijn product has a Boolean diagonal exactly if a cyclic source predecessor exists. B0^4=B0^5, so arbitrarily long zero gaps cap at five. The explicitly shown 5-by-5-by-5 table establishes all possible weight-three obstructions, with one- and two-gap subcases and exact orbit counting. A standalone test recomputed all 125 triples from the local rule and checked 262136 direct source words through ring length 17. Finite checks corroborate; the all-length conclusion follows from matrix stabilization. Boundary convention and orientation were independently scrutinized.

value.rationale: The result identifies the smallest Hamming weight at which cyclic Rule 22 reachability fails, then completely classifies and counts the first nontrivial Garden-of-Eden layer for infinitely many labeled ring lengths. The orientation-sensitive three-gap obstruction gives a sharp stable threshold, not an arbitrary finite census or an incremental numerical improvement. The exact classification can serve as a sparse benchmark for image/predecessor algorithms.
